newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Vanik rejects Asia Capital take-over bid.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Vanik rejects Asia Capital take-over bid.

text.p: Sri Lankan investment bank Vanik Incorporation Ltd said on Thursday it was rejecting an offer from Asia Capital Ltd, to buy its entire issued capital.
"Asia Capital's offer is an unsolicited, unwelcome and hostile bid," Vanik said in a statement. "The directors of Vanik will reject this offer."

Investment bank Asia Capital on Tuesday offered to buy the issued shares of Vanik Incorporation Limited as of November 11, on the basis of 10 rupees in cash and one new share of Asia Capital for each of Vanik's more than 40 million shares.

The directors of Vanik are confident that the majority of shareholders in the company, "for reasons that will be explained to them at the appropriate time, will also reject this offer," the statment said.
The deal would have cost Asia Capital 448.7 million rupees in cash since Vanik's current issued capital stands at 44.87 million 10-rupee shares.
It would also see Asia Capital's issued capital rise to 154.87 million shares, from the current figure of 110 million shares, analysts said.
